_written: 2026-11-02, before any Figure 1 profile or footprint was computed. Grant figure (descriptive).

datasets.endogenous: HEK293T whole-genome Fiber-seq, reads overlapping DPAGT1 (data/kopah_restore/Hek293_Whole_Genome/target_bams/DPATG1_all_reads.bam)
datasets.construct_300bp_peak3: IGVF_construct_mix DPAGT13 (chr11:119,102,160-119,102,459; promoter, 300-600 bp upstream of the DPAGT1 TSS)

cell_line_assumption: plasmid transfections assumed HEK293T (to confirm with the user); endogenous data are HEK293T
subsampling: 300-bp constructs: samtools view -s (seed 42) to ~6,000 reads per construct per replicate from the aligned source BAMs (reps 1 and 2); full-length construct and endogenous: all reads

read_filters.plasmid: primary, aligned to the construct contig, spanning the construct end-to-end within 50 bp (full-length linear molecule); treated = m6A/AT >= 0.05 (excludes the untreated component); resolvable = largest fiberhmm footprint < 30% of the read
read_filters.endogenous: primary reads covering the whole 4.1-kb window; same m6A/AT >= 0.05 filter

footprints: fiberhmm-call --enzyme hia5 --seq pacbio --min-mapq 0 (linear mode; reads are linearised NotI or genomic), default model; size classes: TF-size 10-40 bp, PIC-size 41-80 bp, nucleosome >= 85 bp
profiles: per hg38 position: fraction of molecules covered by each size class, and m6A fraction over A/T bases (accessibility), plasmid and endogenous computed separately and shown on the same hg38 axis
motifs: JASPAR 2026 / HOCOMOCO v14 scan of the 300-bp inserts (P < 1e-5) to label candidate TF footprints (e.g. CTCF)

panel_a_clusters._written: 2026-11-02, before clustering was run (user request: cluster 4.1-kb plasmid reads to show grouping of sub-nucleosome footprints and accessibility in the 300-bp region). Display choice, descriptive.
panel_a_clusters.features: FIRE peak 1 300-bp region chr11:119,100,271-119,100,570 in 10-bp bins; per bin the majority state: accessible (no footprint), 20-35, 35-50, 50-90 bp footprint, nucleosome (>= 90 bp); one-hot
panel_a_clusters.clustering: Ward hierarchical clustering (Euclidean on one-hot), 4 clusters; clusters ordered by their share of accessible bins; reads within a cluster in dendrogram leaf order
panel_a_clusters.display: 60 molecules sampled across clusters in proportion to cluster size (seed 20261102), at least 6 per cluster; cluster share of all 488 molecules labelled
panel_a_clusters.occupancy_tracks: smoothing from the raw per-base shares with Gaussian sigma 3 bp (LRSS used 10 bp); solid fills, no lines; footprint bins x5 on the 300-bp track only; layers drawn tallest first so the shortest peaks are in front

fp_bins_v2._written: 2026-11-02, after the footprint-size scan (fig1_fpsizes.py) and before draft 6; bins chosen by the user from the scan (post hoc, data-derived, descriptive figure)
fp_bins_v2.below_15: calls < 15 bp are not drawn and not counted in any track (short fixed-position calls, likely AT-poor gaps; not verified)

panel_a_accessible._written: 2026-11-02, before draft 6 (user: show only accessible reads with sub-nucleosome footprints, add the CTCF motif). Replaces panel_a_clusters for display.
panel_a_accessible.reads: 300-bp construct DPAGT11 molecules spanning chr11:119,100,271-570 (within 20 bp), accessible (nucleosome calls >= 90 bp cover < 50% of the region) and with >= 1 footprint 15-89 bp whose midpoint lies in the region (fig1_fpsizes definitions)
panel_a_accessible.display: 40 molecules drawn at random (seed 20261102), ordered by Ward clustering (one-hot of 10-bp majority states over the region, fp_bins_v2) in leaf order; footprints only, zoomed to the 300-bp region, with the gene model above (region highlighted, zoom lines) and the HOCOMOCO v14 CTCF motif (119,100,436-455, P 3.8e-6) as a track
panel_a_accessible.panel_b: footprint tracks recomputed from this project's FiberHMM calls (fig1/profiles molecules: endogenous, DPAGT11) with fp_bins_v2: per base, molecules with a call of the class covering it / molecules covering it (span of observed A/T; 300-bp construct limited to its insert); Gaussian sigma 3 bp within covered runs; FIRE layer stays from the LRSS table (FIRE BAMs, independent of footprint bins); sub-nucleosome bins x5 on the 300-bp track only

panel_a_ctcf._written: 2026-11-02, before draft 7 (user: 4.1-kb reads, only CTCF-sized footprints, 10-20 reads clustered on that footprint). Replaces panel_a_accessible for display.
panel_a_ctcf.reads: 300-bp construct (DPAGT11) molecules spanning the CTCF motif (chr11:119,100,436-455) with a 31-60 bp call overlapping it by >= 10 bp: 765 of 9,498 (fig1_ctcf_reads.py)
panel_a_ctcf.availability: 4.1-kb construct: 2 of 488 molecules qualify; 300-bp construct (DPAGT11): 765 of 9,498; endogenous: 1 of 22. The 4.1-kb construct cannot supply 10-20 reads, so draft 7 draws them from the 300-bp construct pending the user's decision (--reads flag selects the source).
panel_a_ctcf.display: 15 molecules drawn at random (seed 20261102), ordered by Ward clustering of per-base 31-60 bp call occupancy over the motif +/- 60 bp (leaf order); drawn over the whole 4,774-bp NotI-linearized plasmid (plasmid coordinate = hg38 - (insert hg38 start - insert construct start), from inserts.tsv): nucleosome calls (>= 90 bp) and 31-60 bp calls only; plasmid map shows backbone, 300-bp insert and CTCF motif (no backbone feature annotation is available, so none is drawn)
panel_a_ctcf.panel_b: endogenous track: nucleosome and FIRE only (no sub-nucleosome footprints); plasmid 300-bp track: all bins, sub-nucleosome x5; CTCF motif marked on the gene model and across both tracks
panel_a_ctcf.renders: PDF/PNG via rsvg-convert with tools/r01_figure/fonts.conf (Arial -> Arimo, metric-compatible), so previews match the SVG layout
panel_a_ctcf._revised: 2026-11-02, before draft 7 was rendered: user chose the 300-bp construct reads, drawn along the whole linearized plasmid, clustered on the CTCF footprint

wasf1._written: 2026-11-03, before any WASF1 read was processed (user: change Figure 1 from DPAGT1 to WASF1; restore approved; 'Decide after a look' on the 300-bp construct; 'Rethink the layout'). Descriptive figure.

datasets.endogenous: HEK293T whole-genome Fiber-seq target reads at WASF1 (data/kopah_restore/Hek293_Whole_Genome/target_bams/WASF1_all_reads.bam; 40 reads)
datasets.full_length_construct: genomic_promoters WASF1 4.5-kb insert chr6:110,176,895-110,181,442 (+ strand in the construct; identity 0.998), merged reps (WASF1.ft.m6a.merged.bam; 1,144 reads)

wasf1.processing: identical to DPAGT1 (this file's subsampling, read_filters, footprints): fig1_fiberhmm.sh and fig1_profiles.py with --gene WASF1; same seeds (samtools -s 42, ~6,000 reads per 300-bp construct per replicate); MA orientation checked per dataset with qc.tsv (flip as DPAGT1 linear-mode BAMs, confirm with the m6A-in-nucleosome share)
wasf1.window: chr6:110,176,895-110,181,442 (full-length insert); endogenous reads clipped to it
wasf1.first_look: before any layout: per-dataset footprint-class profiles (fp_bins_v2) and m6A along the window, motif scan of both 300-bp inserts (fig1_motifs.py, P < 1e-5), gene model (UCSC ncbiRefSeq); choose the 300-bp construct and panels with the user from this
wasf1.cell_line_assumption: as DPAGT1: plasmid transfections assumed HEK293T (unconfirmed)

draft1._written: 2026-11-03, before the WASF1 figure was computed (user: 'use peak 4 and use the same layout and visual appearance as the DPAGT1 figure', i.e. draft 7 / fig1_v10). Descriptive figure.
draft1.motif: SP/KLF GC box chr6:110,180,054-110,180,097 (union of the overlapping best SP1/SP4/KLF matches, HOCOMOCO v14 KLF10 P 7e-10, SP1 P 1.3e-8; fig1_wasf1/motifs/motifs.tsv), drawn where draft 7 drew the CTCF motif
draft1.panel_a_reads: as panel_a_ctcf with the GC box in place of the CTCF motif: WASF12 molecules spanning the GC box (within 20 bp) with a 31-60 bp call overlapping it by >= 10 bp; 15 drawn at random (seed 20261102), Ward clustering of per-base 31-60 bp occupancy over the box +/- 60 bp (leaf order); whole 4,774-bp linearized plasmid; nucleosome and 31-60 bp calls only
draft1.window_b: chr6:110,178,550-110,180,700: WASF1 exons 1-2 (NM_003931.3), peak 4 and CDC40 exon 1 (NM_015891.3); both genes drawn
draft1.fire: the LRSS FIRE table covers only DPAGT1/NAPA; FIRE is computed here the same way (fibertools-rs 0.13: ft add-nucleosomes | ft fire, no --fire-filter; ft extract --all ref_fire_starts/lengths): share = molecules with a FIRE element over the base / molecules covering it, on the kept molecules only (fig1_profiles WASF1 endogenous and WASF12 parquet read IDs); plasmid FIRE limited to the insert and lifted to hg38 with inserts.tsv. Difference from LRSS: input reads are this project's filtered molecules, not LRSS 04_count_filter output
draft1.tracks: as draft 7: endogenous nucleosomes + FIRE; plasmid 300-bp all bins, sub-nucleosome x5; sigma 3 bp

fp_size_scan._written: 2026-11-03, before the scan (user: scan the WASF1 reads to decide the footprint bins). Exploratory; bins are chosen by the user afterwards (post hoc, data-derived), as for DPAGT1 (fp_bins_v2).
fp_size_scan.method: fig1_fpsizes.py unchanged in definitions, run with --gene WASF1: region = WASF12 insert chr6:110,179,911-110,180,211; molecules must span it (within 20 bp); accessible = nucleosome calls (>= 90 bp) cover < 50% of it; sub-nucleosome footprint = call < 90 bp with midpoint in it; datasets WASF1_full (4.5-kb), WASF12 (300-bp), endogenous
fp_size_scan.sites: footprints >= 10 bp overlapping by >= 10 bp, accessible molecules, at the GC box (110,180,054-097), the ZNF444/ZNF281/VEZF1 site (110,179,973-991) and the ZNF143 site (110,180,105-127)

draft2._written: 2026-11-03, after the WASF1 size scan (fp_sizes) and before draft 2 was rendered. User requests: bins from the scan; all footprint sizes on the reads; reads and panel b limited to the 300-bp element, the adjacent nucleosome and the WASF1 gene body (motif kept); reads beside the PacBio icon; FIRE more transparent, TF footprints in front of FIRE in front of nucleosomes; sub-nucleosome scaling at 1x and 2x.
draft2.bins_proposed: post hoc, data-derived, PENDING user approval: calls < 20 bp not drawn or counted; 20-30, 31-48, 49-89 bp; nucleosome >= 90 bp. Splits at the local minima of the 3-bp-smoothed length histogram of accessible-molecule footprints shared by WASF12 and the 4.5-kb construct (19, 30, 37, 48, 55/56, 69); 31-48 holds the 35/40-bp modes and the GC box footprint (median 35 bp, IQR 22-48 in WASF12); 49-89 holds the 51/59/73-bp modes (ZNF143 site median 64)
draft2.panel_a_reads: 15 WASF12 molecules (seed 20261102) drawn at random from those spanning the GC box (within 20 bp) with a 20-89 bp call overlapping it by >= 10 bp; ordered by Ward clustering of one-hot per-base call class (none, each bin, nucleosome) over the insert (leaf order); all bins and nucleosomes drawn; window = insert +/- 170 bp of backbone (plasmid 1,187-1,827), which holds the nucleosomes flanking the insert; placed to the right of the PacBio icon
draft2.window_b: chr6:110,178,550-110,180,380: WASF1 exons 1-2 and intron 1 (gene body near the TSS), peak 4 and its downstream nucleosome (110,180,213-363 at > 50% in endogenous and 4.5-kb reads); CDC40 TSS (110,180,426) falls outside
draft2.tracks: endogenous: nucleosomes + FIRE (as draft 1); plasmid 300-bp: all bins; draw order nucleosome, FIRE (alpha 0.65), then TF bins tallest first; sub-nucleosome scale rendered at 1x and 2x for comparison
draft2.legend: one row between panels a and b

draft3._written: 2026-11-03, before draft 3 was rendered. User: 'Lets do 20-30, 31-50, and 41-80. This will keep the nucleosome bin consistent with figure 3'; reads to match the region in b; select reads with a mix of footprints at the GC box plus a smaller footprint in the 20-30 bp peak.
draft3.bins: user-chosen (post hoc, after the WASF1 size scan): 20-30, 31-50, 51-80 bp, nucleosome >= 81 bp (Figure 3 cut); calls < 20 bp not drawn or counted. The request said '41-80', which overlaps 31-50; read as 51-80 because the nucleosome bin starts at 81 (confirmed by the user 2026-11-03: "yes 51-80 is correct")
draft3.reads_source: only the 4.5-kb construct (WASF1_full, 1,144 molecules) contains the panel-b region, so the reads come from it, drawn in hg38 over the panel-b window
draft3.small_peak: 20-30 bp peak = maximum of the 3-bp-smoothed density of 20-30 bp call midpoints in WASF12 molecules spanning the insert: chr6:110,180,148 (just 3' of the ZNF143 site); the other 20-30 bp density peak sits on the GC box (110,180,076)
draft3.panel_a_reads: 4.5-kb molecules with a 20-80 bp call overlapping the GC box by >= 10 bp AND a separate 20-30 bp call (not overlapping the GC box by >= 10 bp) with midpoint within 110,180,148 +/- 10 bp: 47 of 1,144 (preview count); 15 drawn at random (seed 20261102), Ward clustering of one-hot per-base call class over the peak-4 element; all bins and nucleosomes over the panel-b window
draft3.unchanged: panel b window and tracks (endogenous nucleosome + FIRE; plasmid 300-bp WASF12 all bins), FIRE alpha 0.65, draw order; rendered at --fp-scale 2 and 1

site_check._written: 2026-11-03, before fig1_wasf1_sites.py was run (user: how confident are we in the 20-30 bp footprint, and is there a motif over it or over the 31-50 bp peak on the left?). Exploratory, descriptive; no test.
site_check.method: fig1_wasf1_sites.py: site centres from smoothed call-midpoint density (WASF12); motifs overlapping centre +/- 10 at P < 1e-5 (window scan) and P < 1e-4 (fig1_motifs.py on the element only); A/T count and longest A/T-free run in centre +/- 12; share of spanning molecules with a call of the bin within +/- 10 of the centre, per WASF12 replicate, 4.5-kb and endogenous, against the element-wide median of the same rule (centres every 5 bp); observed A/T and m6A inside each call

draft4._written: 2026-11-03, before draft 4 was rendered (user: crop the reads so the purple footprints at the far right are not shown; 'PacBio HiFi sequencing'; arrow from the sequencer to the reads). Display changes only.
draft4.read_window: panel-a reads and their map end at chr6:110,180,358 (was 110,180,380): the 20-30 bp calls at the far right of the drawn reads start at 110,180,361, after the downstream nucleosome; selection unchanged
draft4.label: schematic label 'PacBio' -> 'PacBio HiFi' (second line 'sequencing' unchanged)
draft4.arrow: arrow from the sequencer icon to the reads; reads block moved right to make room
draft4.bins: 20-30, 31-50, 51-80, nucleosome >= 81 bp (51-80 confirmed by the user)

draft5.fire_reads: fig1_fire.sh on the staged 4.5-kb construct reads (WASF1_full; same ft 0.13 add-nucleosomes | fire, no --fire-filter); per drawn read, FIRE elements from ft extract --all ref_fire_starts/lengths, lifted to hg38 with inserts.tsv (WASF1, + strand) and clipped to X0-READ_X1

ef1a._written: 2026-11-03, before any EF1a molecule was processed (user: Figure 1 panel a to use pEF-GFP, pEF_GFP_Gus replicate 3; first compare the EF1a promoter between plasmid and endogenous HEK293T). Exploratory comparison; descriptive.
ef1a.plasmid: pEF_GFP_Gus replicate 3 = SRA-submission pEFGFP_pSLC39A4_Replicate_3.ft.bam, already staged by the LRSS slides (lrss2026_slides56/pefgfp/pefgfp_r3.span.bam: primary reads spanning the linearized 5,058-bp pEF-GFP within 60 bp, deletion-series variants dropped; 667,972 molecules). Identity of the source: staged size 6.2G = 6,575,197,169 bytes (r2 2.7G = Replicate_2), logs/26_reps23.log
ef1a.subsampling: samtools view -s 42.03 (seed 42, ~3%, ~20,000 molecules) of the spanning BAM for footprints and FIRE (inspection-scale comparison; full set available)
ef1a.endogenous: HEK293T whole-genome Fiber-seq target reads at EEF1A1 (data/kopah_restore/Hek293_Whole_Genome/target_bams/EF1a_all_reads.bam; 30 reads, 28 cover the window)
ef1a.window: plasmid EF1a promoter = pEF-GFP positions 779-1,967 = chr6:73,520,048-73,521,236 (fig1_map.py, + strand, identity 0.9992): 204 bp upstream of the EEF1A1 TSS (73,521,032, - strand, NM_001402.6), exon 1, intron 1 and 8 bp of exon 2

ef1a.comparison: fig1_ef1a_compare.py: per base over the window, share of molecules covered by nucleosome (>= 81 bp), 20-30, 31-50, 51-80 bp calls (Figure 1 bins) and FIRE, and the 51-bp m6A fraction; Spearman of the m6A profiles and of the nucleosome profiles (descriptive; positions are not independent); motif scan of the window (fig1_motifs.py, P < 1e-5) for orientation
